A square-thread screw-jack is used to lower a machine part. The load on the jack applied along and on the line of the axis is \( P = 10,000 \ \mathrm{N} \). The mean thread radius is \( r = 0.025 \ \mathrm{m} \) and the pitch angle of the thread is \( \alpha = 4^{\circ} \). If the appropriate coefficient of static friction is \( \mu = 0.15 \), what is the magnitude of the external moment \( M \) required for screw loosening?

An engineer applies an external moment of \( M = 40 \ \mathrm{N \cdot m} \) to the axis of a square-thread screw-jack to tighten it. The mean thread radius is \( r = 0.02 \ \mathrm{m} \), the pitch angle is \( \alpha = 5^{\circ} \), and the friction angle is \( \phi = 10^{\circ} \). What is the maximum load \( P \) on the jack applied along the line of the axis that can be lifted?

A square-thread screw-jack is used to raise a machine part. The load on the jack applied along and on the line of the axis is \( P = 10,000 \ \mathrm{N} \). The mean thread radius is \( r = 0.025 \ \mathrm{m} \) and the pitch angle of the thread is \( \alpha = 4^{\circ} \). If the appropriate coefficient of static friction is \( \mu = 0.15 \), what external moment \( M \) applied to the axis of the screw is required for screw tightening?

A belt runs over a stationary pulley with a contact angle of \( 120^{\circ} \). If the force applied to resist impending motion is \( F_2 = 150 \ \mathrm{N} \) and the coefficient of static friction is \( \mu = 0.25 \), what is the force \( F_1 \) required to initiate motion?

A worker is using a rope wrapped around a fixed cylindrical post to safely hold a heavy load. The load creates a force of \( F_1 = 3,000 \ \mathrm{N} \) in the direction of impending motion. The rope is wrapped around the post for exactly one full turn. If the coefficient of static friction between the rope and the post is \( \mu = 0.30 \), what is the minimum force \( F_2 \) the worker must apply to resist the impending motion?
